instructions.name: approve_proposal
docs: Milestone 15: add one distinct current-admin approval to a proposal.

instructions.name: claim_rewards
docs: Milestone 12: claim whole REWARD base units, preserving scaled remainder.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Milestone 8: close only an empty, reward-free position owned by signer.

instructions.name: close_proposal
docs: Milestone 16: close only executed, expired, or stale proposals to creator.

instructions.name: create_proposal
docs: Milestone 15: create one immutable allowlisted admin proposal.

instructions.name: emergency_withdraw
docs: Milestone 14: return all principal and recycle the user's reward entitlement.

instructions.name: execute_proposal
docs: Milestone 16: execute exactly one approved proposal action once.

instructions.name: fund_rewards
docs: Milestone 9: checkpoint, transfer real REWARD tokens, then credit budget.

instructions.name: initialize_pool
docs: Milestone 7: create the canonical pool account and PDA-owned vault ATAs.

accounts.name: pool_authority
docs: canonical seeds here and it only acts as the vault ATA authority.

instructions.name: open_position
docs: Milestone 8: create one canonical empty position for a user in a pool.

instructions.name: pause_pool
docs: Milestone 13: any current admin can checkpoint and immediately pause.

instructions.name: stake
docs: Milestone 10: stake canonical STAKE ATA principal after checkpoint and settlement.

instructions.name: unstake
docs: Milestone 11: unstake principal only, preserving settled rewards.
